# `nlink-lab snapshot restore`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Bring the lab back to a snapshot: `apply` its topology, then put back its runtime impairments and partitions.

Restores what nlink-lab manages, not hand-made `ip`/`tc` edits inside the namespaces. `--dry-run` prints the plan.

Usage: nlink-lab snapshot restore [OPTIONS] <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>
          Snapshot name (see `nlink-lab snapshot ls`)

Options:
  -L, --lab <LAB>
          The lab. Default: `$NLINK_LAB`, then the one `nlink-lab use` selected, then the only running lab

      --dry-run
          Show the plan without changing anything

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
